reflow_surface_label: Example State official voter-information reflow and text-scaling fail-open policy
delivery_role_note: Critical official voter-information routes remain readable and actionable on narrow viewports, enlarged-text states, and ordinary browser zoom rather than assuming desktop width or default text size.
text_resize_review_note: Critical text, labels, dates, controls, and help/contact instructions remain usable when text is enlarged to the bounded review threshold.
zoom_enablement_note: The route does not disable user zoom and does not treat magnified reading as an unsupported edge case.
reflow_behavior_note: Ordinary reading content reflows into a linear path without forcing horizontal panning through text.
horizontal_scroll_exception_note: Any remaining two-dimensional exceptions are limited to elements such as maps, tables, or viewers and do not become the sole carrier of the official answer.
sticky_ui_obscuration_note: Sticky headers, footers, floating controls, and utility chrome are reviewed so they do not hide the answer lane or action controls on small screens.
control_visibility_note: Lookup fields, submit controls, and office/help links remain reachable and labeled when the viewport shrinks or text grows.
map_table_parallel_text_fallback_note: When maps, tables, or similar two-dimensional elements exist, the route preserves a parallel readable text/help path for first contact.
file_or_viewer_fallback_note: If a document viewer or file handoff is hard to use on the viewport under review, a readable first-party fallback remains available.
same_answer_across_viewports_note: Viewport size, text enlargement, and zoom may change layout but do not silently change the underlying authoritative answer.
manual_help_contact_note: A visible first-party help/contact lane remains available when small-screen layout or magnification makes enrichment harder to use.
